items.summary: Veteran video game actor Nolan North has addressed his future in the Call of Duty series, saying he hopes to r

content.v: Veteran video game actor Nolan North has addressed his future in the Call of Duty series, saying he hopes to reprise his character Dr. Edward Richtofen from Black Ops' popular Zombies mode.

If this does happen, it probably won't be soon. That's because, North said he believes 2027's Call of Duty game might be developed by Sledgehammer. Given that, a new Black Ops game might not come until 2028 at the soonest, but this is just conjecture.
Speaking at Gamergy in Puerto Rico ( via DomTheBomb ), North said he hopes Richtofen's story continues in a future Black Ops game, whenever that might be.

"I always like when they leave things open for the next one. I know that Infinity Ward and I think Sledgehammer has the next two before there is another Black Ops. I just don't want it to be the end of Richtofen, and I don't think it is," he said.

North clarified that he does not know for sure that Richotfen's story will continue, so he hoped people wouldn't think he had some inside knowledge apart from his own hope and belief. Whatever the case, North said Richotofen is one of his favorite characters to voice, and he hopes to reprise him someday.

North first appeared as Richtofen in 2008's World at War, and has reprised the role many times over in subsequent games from developer Treyarch. He's a fan-favorite character in the fan-favorite Zombies mode, with the story taking numerous twists and turns over the years.
"It's been such a pleasure getting to work with my friends for so long, just like Uncharted was," he said.

On the subject of Uncharted, North said he hopes to come back to play Nathan Drake once more . As it happens, rumors are swirling that Naughty Dog is working on Uncharted 5 and that Drake might have a role in it.

Regarding North's statement that Sledgehammer is working on the 2027 Call of Duty game, that's not confirmed, but doesn't seem outrageous given this has been reported since 2024 . The studio's last game where it served as lead developer was 2023's Modern Warfare 3, so it might be time for Sledgehammer to take the lead again in 2027. Intriguingly, it's also been reported that Activision's new ownership of the Halo franchise could include Sledgehammer, or at least a division inside the developer, working on a Halo game .
This year's Call of Duty game is Modern Warfare 4, and Infinity Ward is leading development. The game releases on October 23 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

items.title: Solo Horror Dev 与墨西哥真实的闹鬼岛屿建立了令人毛骨悚然的联系
items.summary: Being a haunted doll must be difficult. You're missing an eyeball, and your lipstick makes you look more like

content.v: Being a haunted doll must be difficult. You're missing an eyeball, and your lipstick makes you look more like a cannibal than a cherub. People make faces of disgust at you in the antique mall, and you want to tell them you're actually the unblemished soul of a 19th century nun named Eunice, but they speed away before you can. But if you were a haunted doll, you'd at least have solo developer Steelkrill Studio on your side, as its upcoming survival horror game Where Dolls Hang features real-life creepy dolls looking proudly injured.

The dolls of Mexico's Isla de las Muñecas , the Island of the Dolls, have been through a lot over the past 80 years. Folklore suggests the bald dolls cobwebbed and nailed to the island's trees contain the spirit of a drowned little girl, who caretaker Don Julian Santana may or may not have made up. In any case, he spent much of his life fishing plastic Barbies and babies out of the water near his home to honor her spirit. So Where Dolls Hang, which was featured in the Horror Game Awards' recent showcase this past summer, is a tribute, too--it honors the fact that our real world is often freakier than fiction.

"Some of the doll models you'll find were created using real photographs," developer Steelkrill explains on Twitter . "The photographs can also be found around in the game." An accompanying clip of first-person gameplay footage demonstrates with an image of a doll head coated completely in dirt and little pimples from raindrops. The Where Dolls Hang player then drops the photo and stares ahead; the same pimply doll head is sticking from a pike right in front of them.

"It creates an unusual connection between the game's horrors and reality: something disturbing hanging in a room or sitting in the darkness may not have been designed entirely from imagination," a press release says. "Somewhere in the world, there may be a real photograph behind it." Intriguingly, that makes Where Dolls Hang a rare game that is based on a true story, since life is unknowable without art to make sense of it.
Where Dolls Hang is scheduled for a 2026 release date, and it's available to wishlist now on Steam .

others.title: Warhammer Survivors is more than just a Vampire Survivors spin-off
《战锤》类似吸血鬼幸存者的疯狂像素动作游戏将于 11 月登陆 PS5
《战锤幸存者》不仅仅是吸血鬼幸存者的克隆版，它旨在成为两全其美的庆典 | IGN 预览

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/05/warhammersurvivors-blogroll-01-1791227173937.jpg

There are few things more rewarding than the tide turning in your favor in Vampire Survivors. Starting as a weak soldier with one small attack and a fear of even the smallest foe, you soon become a literal weapon of mass destruction and turn a bullet hell of enemies into your own personal bullet heaven.

And you know what can make that feeling even better? Doing it with some trusty allies from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes while using weapons pulled not just from the lore, but those inspired by how we engage with the tabletop game. Yes, we’re talking about the very dice we roll and paint we use to bring our miniatures to life. That, my friends, is Warhammer Survivors.
Warhammer Survivors Honors Warhammer 40,000 and Age of Sigmar’s Tabletop and Video Games

Warhammer Survivors is a standalone game developed and published by Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s Auroch Digital in partnership with Vampire Survivors’ Poncle, and it initially feels like returning home to the original title. However, you’ll quickly start to notice that it does enough things to stand tall on its own.

I spent a few hours with the demo you can download right now on PC via Steam and Xbox ahead of its November 10, 2026 release date, and I was able to check out both the Warhammer 40,000 side of the game and the Warhammer Age of Sigmar side. You read that right, there are two separate games included with their own unlocks, stages, achievements, and more.

We’ll start in Warhammer 40,000, as I first jumped into the armored shoes of Boltgun’s Malum Caedo, who starts with the Chainsword that is the weapon of choice for those within the Imperium of Man. However, in Vampire Survivors fashion, you quickly level up and gain access to new Weapons and Passives that make you increasingly more powerful.

As I teased before, you’ll find Boltguns and Lasguns and even Whirlwind Batteries that rain down missiles from above, but it’s the tabletop-inspired items that got me the most excited. If you are entrenched in the Warhammer universe, you’ll be very familiar with Nuln Oil, a very popular shade of paint. In Warhammer Survivors, this becomes a weapon that targets groups of enemies and damages them by splashing them with flammable oil.

Another fun weapon is the D6 Dice, which is inspired by the same dice that fuel its tabletop games. In Warhammer Survivors, these are represented by massive dice that come flying in off screen and will explode depending on what number they land on.

So not only are these giving a nod to the tabletop experience in a clever way, but they are giving it some serious gameplay ramifications, as enemies drenched in this Nuln Oil are even more susceptible to fire damage. This is all taken to greater heights when you learn there is an actual Hobby Table stage that has you playing on a workstation and that there’s a Paint Pot system that unlocks characters when certain combinations of colors are used. These little touches are so clever and don’t feel forced, they feel earned and welcome and add to the entire experience, just like the ally system.

In traditional Vampire Survivors, players are facing an endless horde of enemies by themselves and an array of weapons that fly in every direction away from and around them. In Warhammer Survivors, you get to bring some NPC friends along for the ride, and it’s awesome.

If you played Vampire Survivors’ Ode to Castlevania DLC, you’ll have a base understanding of how this works as they had a similar Familiars system, but you’ll be able to recruit other characters from the Warhammer universe to help you out on your run by choosing to select the weapons they would normally wield in the canon.

As an example, I may have started as Malum Caedo, but I was able to quickly add Trooper Bartosz Kozlowski to my crew (after I rescued him on the map from a circle of enemies and unlocked him as a playable character!) by choosing the Lasgun weapon. He followed me around and shot las bolts at the nearest enemy, and even more Astra Militarum troops joined as I leveled up the weapon. It honestly gave me the slightest link to Mass Effect 2, as I looked forward to recruiting all my allies for this epic war each run presented me with.

As for the runs themselves, they lasted anywhere from five minutes to over 20, and I enjoyed how there were always things to chase after. One of these objectives, which is represented by a question mark, is how you find characters like Trooper Bartosz Kozlowski or The Legend of Catachan. The latter character was the biggest challenge of the demo for me as he was surrounded by a circle of Warriors, who all used their Synapse Emitters to make any enemies within a close range of them even more powerful. Conquering that and unlocking The Legend of Catachan with a fun Super Smash Bros.-esque “Joins the battle!” screen was definitely a victory worth celebrating.

There are also a handful of objectives to accomplish that will unlock even more Weapons, Passives, and more, and it was a pleasant surprise when five or more of them unlocked after one run. These types of games just know how to give you that dopamine rush that keeps you coming back for more.

This was only the demo, so we’ll see how the full game plays out, but after rescuing the two characters and getting most of the objectives after a couple of hours, I did feel a bit of tedium start to set in. My biggest problem with Vampire Survivors was always feeling that the start could be very, very slow, as you are so weak and doing the same things over and over again, and I felt this a few times during my hands-on.

For example, to unlock The Legend of Catachan, I had to walk for nearly two minutes northeast to find him, and the grind started to show its ugly face after the fourth or fifth try as the movement is slow at first and you aren’t so powerful. There is supposed to be so much content in the full game - 40+ characters, 75+ weapons, 15+ stages, and countless objectives - so it will hopefully mitigate that somewhat, but it just reminded me of one of my few annoyances with Vampire Survivors.
Vermintide and Stormvermin and Clanrats!

For the last part of the story, we’re going to leave the Tyranids of Warhammer 40,000 and hop over to Warhammer Age of Sigmar and the ruthless Skaven. The two campaigns play the exact same, but it was fun jumping into a new universe and being able to unlock things all over again and take on a new foe. These enemies kept me on my toes, and the rat-like Vermintide may have been the most surprising. While I’m used to hordes and hordes of enemies descending on me every run, the Vermintide would, once in a while, swarm in horizontal lines on top of it all. This caused me to shift my strategy every time and actually gave the feeling of a bullet hell as I was weaving in and out of the rodent procession.

I also had my best run of the demo in Age of Sigmar as Neave Blacktalon, as this is when the stars aligned and the chests from stronger green-highlighted enemies were very much in my favor. These chests are all RNG-based, but when they shine on you, you can unlock upgrades for up to five Weapons or Passives, and it feels so great. What it also does, however, is get you closer to evolving said Weapons.

items.summary: Sticker shock might be underselling it with GameStop's new used pricing for Sony's most powerful system. Start

content.v: Sticker shock might be underselling it with GameStop's new used pricing for Sony's most powerful system. Starting today, the video game store is listing pre-owned PS5 Pros for $1,400, though GameStop Pro members only need to dish out $1,330. Basically, it's a $500 surcharge over a brand-new PS5 Pro and capitalizing on the fact that those are stock-constrained currently.

A generous take on GameStop's new strategy for used PS5 Pros is that the company's conditioning us ahead of the possibility that the PS6 could cost $1,000 or more . Obviously, Sony isn't the only one increasing hardware pricing and consoles probably aren't getting cheaper anytime soon --mainly because of the ongoing chip shortage from AI development.

A more cynical take is that GameStop is taking advantage of the situation similar to what scalpers do with the launch of new video game consoles. I'm also curious how many people now trade in a PS5 Pro at GameStop when they see how much the company is then reselling it for. Wouldn't an easier option just be to undercut them on Facebook Marketplace or eBay by $100?

Similar pricing for used PS5 Pro systems can be seen on Amazon and Best Buy's storefronts. One key difference here is that those are third-party sellers, such as this RYTEK example at Best Buy . GameStop is officially behind the pre-owned pricing on its own website.

Sony raised pricing for PS5, PS5 Pro, and PlayStation Portal in April. The PS5 Pro was $750 previously and now retails for $900, if you can find one. When PS5 Pro originally launched in November 2024 , the system cost $700. Meanwhile, the Xbox lineup also saw another round of price hikes in August, with the cheapest option being an Xbox Series S for $500. This is the first generation of video game systems to increase in price dramatically over the years , instead of getting much cheaper.

items.title: 《战锤幸存者》在《GTA 6》前几天推出，我尊重他们的大胆
items.summary: The next Survivors-like game--or Survivaton, as Vampire Survivors developer Poncle refers to them--is out soon

content.v: The next Survivors-like game--or Survivaton, as Vampire Survivors developer Poncle refers to them--is out soon, and it's threatening to cut into GTA 6 playtime. Warhammer Survivors launches November 10 on PC, consoles, and mobile devices, and you can also grab a new demo on PC via Steam right now.

Set in the grim (and dark) 41st millennium of the Warhammer 40,000 franchise, Warhammer Survivors sticks to the Vampire Survivors playbook : You'll fight all manner of Tyranid enemies that threaten the Imperium of Man, evolve your weapons, and die a lot before you're strong enough to start easily tanking the waves of heretical creatures. Extremis bosses will push your builds to the limit, and when it launches, the game will feature over 40 playable characters and an arsenal of 70 weapons to collect.

Warhammer Survivors will release on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and Switch next month, and it'll also be available via Xbox Game Pass. The new demo will give you a fresh taste of the carnage, featuring the heroes Lyssa Revenya and the Legend of Catachan.

It's one of the few November games willing to take a risk and launch close to November 19, as many publishers and developers have opted to avoid the GTA 6-sized elephant in the room . Only a few games are standing their ground, including one that features the king of the monsters , Godzilla.

This isn't the only Survivaton on the way, as Poncle is also working on Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble . Like Vampire Survivors and Warhammer Survivors, it features the same bullet-heaven gameplay, but it draws from the manga and anime series' Culling Games storyline to shift the focus toward a "survivors royal" experience. The goal is to exorcise cursed spirits, grow your power, and outscore your opponents to be the last player standing. Originally scheduled to launch this year, the release date was shifted to 2027.

items.title: 如何立即以 80 美元购买 GTA 6 的 100 美元版
items.summary: If you're looking for GTA 6 's $100 Ultimate Edition but don't want to pay that much, there is a way to get it

content.v: If you're looking for GTA 6 's $100 Ultimate Edition but don't want to pay that much, there is a way to get it for $80--if you meet a few requirements.

Costco has rolled out a nice new deal where you can get four $25 PlayStation Store gift cards for $80. Or you can buy two $75 gift cards for $120 . These offers are good through October 11 or while supplies last, so act fast.
While Costco does not require people to have a membership ($65/year) to shop online, the deals for these PlayStation gift cards are listed as "members only."

While GTA 6's $80 edition will be sold in stores via a code in a box, GTA 6's $100 edition will seemingly not be sold in stores. This makes the $100 edition even more profitable for Rockstar and Take-Two because digital games have better margins than games sold in stores.

The $100 Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 comes with many digital extras, including special weapon variants, a retro-inspired car, a boat, and special clothing. Additionally, the premium edition is the only way you can get access to a range of in-game stores and locations, including Rideout Customs for updating your car, Sara's Unisex Salon for getting a new haircut, and Electric Fang Tattoo for getting some ink.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/jasonandlucia-Large-1.jpeg

It remains to be seen what will happen for those who buy the $80 edition with regard to these shops. Are the doors of these stores locked? Is there a literal paywall where you have to fork over extra cash to get in? Do they not even appear in the world for $80 players? Rockstar and Take-Two are well-versed in microtransactions, and the game's ESRB rating says these will be in the game , but we don't know yet how it will work in practice.

GTA 6 becomes available to preload beginning November 12, and that applies to the game's digital and physical versions sold at retailers. The game unlocks to play on November 19 across PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 《腐烂国度 3》提前发布的部分原因是工作室老板对 Xbox 计划的焦虑
items.summary: Undead Labs boss Philip Holt reveals why the studio announced State of Decay 3 so early.

content.v: According to the boss of former Microsoft-owned Undead Labs, State of Decay 3 was revealed early because of concern that the studio might have got "swallowed up or divested before we had a chance to present to the world what we were working on."
The comments came in an interview with The Game Business , during which Holt admitted that while a small team was working on the game in 2020, development didn’t pick up until 2023.

State of Decay 3 was revealed during an Xbox showcase six years ago, in 2020, two years after the release of State of Decay 2. The zombie series features a simulated apocalypse where players have to manage food, resources, and the moods of their people while avoiding having their faces bitten off by the undead.

The anxiety Undead Labs had came from Xbox’s acquisition spree. Microsoft acquired Undead Labs , alongside PlayGround Games, Ninja Theory, and Compulsion Games, in 2018. Undead Labs went independent last month , Ninja Theory developers are being laid off amid a studio closure , and Compulsion Games is charting its own path .

State of Decay 3’s announcement trailer was supposed to be a mission statement, but it didn’t really reflect what the team had, because the team had very little. “I got myself in a little trouble saying we didn’t really have a team working on the game at that point,” Holt said. “It’s not entirely true, but we had a really small team.

“It was a relatively small game inside a giant organization,” Holt said later in the interview. “I didn’t think Microsoft was done being acquisitive, and I didn’t think they were going to continue buying small developers. I figured they’d start buying big things.” Xbox announced its intention to purchase Activision Blizzard in 2022 .

“I was a little worried about getting swallowed up or even divested before we had a chance to present to the world what we were working on,” Holt continued. "It was a bit of a marker on the table for me. We’re saying State of Decay 3, we’re announcing it, it’s public, the audience now knows it’s in development.”

Elsewhere in the interview, Holt talked about development of State of Decay 3, which was largely informed by post-launch updates to State of Decay 2. State of Decay 2 became a laboratory to test ideas for State of Decay 3 — "it all informed design for State of Decay 3," Holt said.

State of Decay 3 remains in active development, despite significant layoffs at Undead Labs , and it will launch day one on Game Pass. The cuts came after the studio split from Microsoft and went independent.
Last month, Halo Studios also suffered layoffs . Meanwhile, Halo has been given to Activision, who will assign a team to work on the next game in the Halo series.

items.summary: MTG x Star Trek Play Booster set preorders are almost 20% off in the Amazon Prime Day sale, a month out from i

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/star-trek-boosters-on-sale-1787234785687.png
Magic: The Gathering’s 2026 roadmap includes a whopping seven sets this year, and the last one of the year is its fourth Universes Beyond property.

While Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles didn’t make as much of a splash as we’d have hoped, Marvel Superheroes and The Hobbit have been great - but what about Star Trek? The legendary sci-fi franchise feels like a natural evolution from last year’s Edge of Eternities, and while we’ve not gone hands-on just yet (we’re still having too much fun with Reality Fracture), it’s actually already seeing discounts.
If you’re looking to swiftly build up a collection of Star Trek cards, a Play Booster box at 19% off is one of the best ways to go.
Save Almost 20% on Star Trek Play Booster Boxes for Prime Day
What’s the number, you ask? The MSRP for a Universes Beyond Play Booster Box is $209.70, but this one is now selling for $170.61.

You get a foil in every pack (which may be exciting for you), but the big thing here is that you’re getting 30 packs. If you paid the MSRP, you’d be paying the actual MSRP of $6.99 per pack, so you wouldn’t be getting any discounts for buying a box in bulk.
On the other hand, with this deal, you’re spending $5.68 per pack, so you’re saving just over a dollar on each one.

If the price drops any further between now and launch, you’ll only ever pay the lowest amount thanks to Amazon’s Preorder Price Guarantee, so while you’re paying less already, that might even drop further. At the time of writing, however, this price is just shy of a new low - that was last week at around $165.

It’s worth noting that Play Boosters aren’t the packs you’ll want to reach for if you’re looking for the rarest cards, since those are much more likely to be found in Collector Boosters, which go for around $40 a pop (when you can find them).

items.title: 10.2.0 |中章
items.summary: Survivors can send and receive text messages during a match By pressing and holding the scroll-button when usi

content.v: Survivors can send and receive text messages during a match
By pressing and holding the scroll-button when using a Mouse, or the right d-pad input on controllers, players can open the messages wheel
8 messages are available for players to select and send
Hovering the message, and releasing scroll-button/right, will send the message
Inputs are customizable
Sent messages are shown to all Survivors, next to their information on the left side of the screen
Messages are predefined
Players can customize on Settings their messages selection
On Match Details, Players can mute and unmute any other player during a match
Muting is not communicated to the muted player
On Settings, players can deactivate the system, if they want to opt out
On Match Details, Players that have deactivated the system are marked with a "no" icon to surface that they have opted out
For reducing spamming, a 1s cooldown is applied when players send messages too quickly
If a player keeps spamming, their cooldown will increase up to 5 seconds
Waiting before sending new messages will reset the cooldown to its shortest duration
The "Gameplay" section has been added to Settings
The options for the system are on the Gameplay Tab, under "Messages"
Abandon Option
Survivor Condition - When all other Survivors are bots, the remaining human Survivor gains the option to Abandon
Survivor is considered Abandoned
Killer Condition - When all remaining Survivors are bots, and at least 1 is not in the Dying State, the Killer gains the option to Abandon (new condition)
Killer is considered Abandoned
Survivor outcome depends on what state they were in when the Killer Abandoned
Surrender Option
Survivor Condition - When all the Survivors are in the Dying State simultaneously, Survivors gain the option to Surrender (previously Abandon )
Survivors are considered Surrendered
End Trial Option
Killer Condition - When all remaining Survivors are bots, and in the Dying State, the Killer gains the option to End Trial (new condition)
Survivor outcome depends on what state they were in when the Killer Ends Trial
Dev Note:
We removed two existing conditions that could promote negative gameplay behaviours or cause players to leave prematurely. The conditions that were removed are:
Survivor Condition - If a Survivor repeatedly recovers from being downed
Killer Condition - If no Generator has been completed or worked on for a prolonged window
We added and adjusted existing conditions to ensure the feature's intentions are being met. The intention behind every option type is as follows:
Abandon: Gives a Survivor/Killer the opportunity to leave a Trial if conditions do not promote fair or engaging gameplay (i.e. too many bots). This counts as an MMR draw.
Surrender: Gives a Survivor the opportunity to leave a Trial if the outcome is inevitable and unfavourable. This counts as an MMR loss.

End Trial: Gives a Killer the opportunity to prematurely end a Trial if the outcome is inevitable and favourable. All remaining bot Survivors are Sacrificed, and the MMR outcome depends on the total match results.

Dev Note: With this release, we are doing a pass on general perks - the perks new players gain access to when they begin their journey. We want to update them because a lot of them haven't been updated in a long time. Dead by Daylight has changed a lot over the years, so it felt right to adjust these and give them more utility or strength. Between making perk tiers closer in terms of strength, simplification or other improvements, there's something for everyone. Additionally, having released the Diminishing Returns system a few updates ago, we've looked at perks we felt could use some adjustments to account for this system being in the game.

items.title: 22岁的选美冠军遭雷劈！不幸身亡
items.summary: 巴西一名22岁的选美冠军遭遇雷击，不幸身亡

content.v: 巴西一名22岁的选美冠军安娜·贝阿特丽斯·阿劳霍·费雷拉（Ana Beatriz Araújo Ferreira）于10月3日（周六）在家庭午餐期间遭遇雷击，不幸身亡。事发时，她正在母亲位于阿尔马斯市的花园里，为年幼的侄女梳头。
据其兄弟塞萨尔·奥古斯托回忆，悲剧发生在一瞬间。闪电突然击中了她，家人随即将其紧急送往医院，但安娜最终在当天晚些时候被宣告死亡。事发时，一家人正在花园里聚餐。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062230158678.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062230177674.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062230185317.png
安娜曾是一名牛仔竞技选美皇后，被媒体形容为“模特妈妈”，身后留下一个5岁的孩子。目前尚不清楚雷击发生时花园内是否有其他人员受伤，当地相关部门也未公布更多细节。

items.summary: 《永恒之塔2》Steam峰值破40万！角色胸部随便调

content.v: NC旗下MMORPG《永恒之塔2》于10月5日正式上线全球服，Steam版迅速迎来大批玩家涌入，最高同时在线人数一度达到约40万人。按照SteamDB数据，发稿时仍有约24.7万名玩家在线，仅次于《反恐精英2》和《Dota 2》，成为Steam同时在线人数第三高的游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061119012079.png
《永恒之塔2》是《永恒之塔》的续作，故事发生在前作200年后的阿特雷亚。随着“艾欧娜之塔”崩塌，世界被分裂为多个区域，天族、魔族以及获得新力量的龙族展开对立。玩家则将作为半神“迪瓦”探索这片全新世界。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061119105156.png
本作最大卖点之一是大幅扩张的开放世界，地图规模达到前作的36倍，不仅能够自由地面探索，还可以飞行探索，并展开空中战斗。同时，游戏提供相当细致的角色创建系统，从睫毛颜色到体型、胸部腹部轮廓甚至血管细节都能调整，还能通过装备搭配打造个性化角色。
《永恒之塔2》并非突然出现的新作，韩国、中国台湾地区早在2025年11月上线，并在100天内创造约117亿元人民币营收。全球服开启前，9月30日的抢先体验也曾达到约17万同时在线。
目前Steam玩家评价约1万条，其中71%为好评，已达到“褒贬不一”向“多半好评”的改善。不过游戏此前也因服务器排队、登录问题以及复杂的付费系统受到批评。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061119405263.png

其中，胸部滑块尤为精细，可分别调整：
胸廓大小
胸廓长度
胸部大小
胸部上部体积
胸部位置
背阔肌

此前我们曾报道过一则与叶奈法有关的消息 。一名《巫师》系列玩家曾在Reddit发帖称，自己在参加签售活动时遇到了叶奈法英文配音演员丹妮丝·高夫，对方透露自己正在为《巫师》系列录制新的台词，其中部分内容与希里有关。
如果这一消息属实，那么叶奈法未来继续出现在《巫师》系列作品中并不令人意外。《巫师4》的主角已经确定为希里，而叶奈法与希里之间有着十分深厚的关系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061432455225.png
不过，目前没有官方消息能够确认丹妮丝·高夫录制的新台词究竟属于《巫师4》，还是CD Projekt RED正在开发的《巫师3：狂猎》新扩展《旧时曲》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061433563715.png
在《巫师3：狂猎》中，叶奈法和特莉丝都是杰洛特的重要感情线角色。玩家在游戏过程中可以分别与两人发展关系，并最终通过自己的选择决定杰洛特的感情归宿。
叶奈法是杰洛特长期以来的重要伴侣之一，也是希里生命中非常重要的人物。在《巫师3》中，她与杰洛特一同寻找希里，并在旅途中逐渐恢复两人之间的关系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061433278692.png
特莉丝则是杰洛特的另一位重要感情对象。她在诺维格瑞剧情中扮演重要角色，并帮助受到迫害的法师逃离城市。玩家同样可以通过一系列选择与她发展恋爱关系。
两条感情线也因此成为《巫师3》玩家社区长期讨论的话题。

items.title: 《战神劳菲》女主演猛夸：最好的作品 职业最佳！
items.summary: 《战神劳菲》女主演猛夸：最好的作品 职业最佳！

content.v: 在近日的Comic-Con活动上，演员Deborah Ann Woll谈到了自己参与的《战神：劳菲》项目，并毫不掩饰地给出了极高评价。她表示，这部作品不仅拥有精彩的故事和优秀团队，更是自己整个演艺生涯中“毫无疑问最出色的项目”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061034555877.jpg
Deborah Ann Woll称，项目团队在制作过程中投入了大量时间和精力，从演员表现到剧情设计，再到各种细节处理，都展现出了极高的标准。她尤其强调，团队始终在思考如何让作品真正抓住玩家注意力，希望让玩家始终保持紧张和期待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061036098454.jpg
她表示：“这是一个精彩的故事，也拥有一支非常出色的团队。每个人都拿出了自己最好的状态。”在她看来，无论是演员的投入、团队的专业程度，还是对于细节的重视程度，都让整个项目显得与众不同。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061035457825.jpg
值得注意的是，Deborah Ann Woll此前已经参与过多部广受关注的影视项目，因此当她被问及此次作品与过去经历相比如何时，给出的答案相当明确。她表示，虽然职业生涯中曾经完成过不少优秀作品，但这一次的《战神：劳菲》“远远是自己最好的项目”。
她同时提到，目前团队依然在持续打磨作品，希望进一步提升整体沉浸感，让玩家能够真正投入故事之中，而不是单纯完成任务。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061035598307.jpg

content.v: 近日有爆料称，Xbox Design Lab后台出现了一款全新的Xbox Elite手柄，代号为“Edessa”，个性化名称为“Beatrice”。该手柄在定制选项中列出了多项新特性，疑似为Elite系列的新一代产品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610060908324182.jpg
根据曝光信息，新款Elite手柄的主要配置包括：
摇杆：霍尔摇杆（标准、松、紧三档）及TMR摇杆
触觉反馈：脉冲扳机（ERM）+ 高级触觉（VCA）
音频滚轮
材质与细节：金属面板、雕刻及静音摇杆
更多拨片：短、长、经典、双宽、蝴蝶及无上部拨片
性能十字键
目前微软尚未正式公布该手柄，上述信息仍属传闻。若消息属实，这将是Xbox Elite系列的一次重要更新。更多详情有待官方后续公开。

items.title: 《永恒之塔2》登顶Steam热游榜！这雷把我吓死了
items.summary: NCSoft旗下MMORPG《永恒之塔2》正式上线全球服，Steam版迅速涌入大批玩家

content.v: NCSoft旗下MMORPG《永恒之塔2》正式上线全球服，Steam版迅速涌入大批玩家，登顶全球热玩榜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061513466463.png

这一热度在抢先体验阶段已有预兆。9月30日面向创始人包购买者开启的付费抢先体验首日，最高同时在线便达到171,530人，此后工作日维持在13万至14万，周末维持在14万至15万。凭借最低24.99美元、最高99.99美元的创始人礼包收入，游戏在抢先体验开启当天便登顶Steam全球畅销榜，并在巴西、加拿大、法国、意大利、波兰、新加坡、西班牙、泰国八个国家登顶。正式上线后，游戏在Steam的畅销榜、人气新作和热门免费作品三个榜单同时位列第一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061526362621.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061526375346.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061526387769.png
《永恒之塔2》是2008年经典MMORPG《永恒之塔》的正统续作，故事发生在前作200年后的阿特雷亚。本作地图规模达到前作的36倍，玩家可以自由地面探索，也能飞行展开空中战斗。游戏提供细致的角色创建系统，从睫毛颜色到体型轮廓甚至血管细节均可调整，采用免费游玩模式，支持8种语言。

content.v: 《巫师3：狂猎重制版》是2015年CDPR经典奇幻冒险RPG《巫师3：狂猎》的现代重制，已于9月29日正式上线，所有已经拥有原版游戏的玩家均可免费升级。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610060859113736.jpg
据Insider Gaming报道，CDPR在推特上发布的一篇新帖文透露了《巫师3：狂猎重制版》即将推出的改进。第一项内容就明确表示，开发团队正在进行进一步的性能优化，“尤其针对PS5”。许多PS5玩家都报告遇到了帧率下降、卡顿、崩溃以及其他问题，因此希望开发团队能够尽快解决这些问题。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610060900006548.jpg
开发团队还确认，上述列出的许多问题都应该会在下一次更新中得到修复。与此同时，他们也正在调查其他问题以及玩家反馈的各种情况。

items.title: 《生化》新电影病毒太狠！里昂来了感觉也够呛
items.summary: 《生化》新电影病毒太狠！里昂来了也够呛

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061145177606.png
由你来说： 新《生化危机》电影里的病毒到底有多夸张？有玩家看完后直言，这次的病毒不仅比T病毒、G病毒甚至4代普拉卡寄生虫更加离谱，连“生化危机劳模”里昂来了都未必能轻松通关。还有人表示，整部电影散发出的压迫感甚至让自己想起了《死亡空间》。你觉得这次电影是真的拍出了游戏味，还是单纯把病毒能力堆得太夸张了？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061148417221.png
新《生化危机》真人电影《生化危机：爆发夜》近期引发玩家讨论。影片故事发生在浣熊市病毒灾难爆发时期，不过没有直接复刻里昂、克莱尔等经典主角的故事，而是围绕医疗快递员布莱恩展开，导演此前也明确表示，希望讲述一个发生在《生化危机》世界观中的全新故事。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061148418295.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061148149642.jpg
而真正让玩家讨论起来的，是电影中展现出的新型病毒以及变异生物。部分观众认为，这种病毒的表现已经明显超出了传统T病毒、G病毒的范畴：感染者不仅会发生严重变异，身体受到致命伤害后还可能出现更加诡异的生物变化，甚至能够继续吞噬、融合和进化。 网络AI梗图
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061146042719.png
有玩家因此开玩笑表示，如果当年的新人警察里昂是在这个版本的浣熊市第一天上任，恐怕也得经历一场“地狱难度”。不过另一派玩家则认为，里昂毕竟是系列最著名的特工之一，真把他丢进去，最后大概率还是能够靠枪械、体术和各种临场操作杀出一条路。类似“里昂来了也汗流浃背”的讨论，在玩家社区中已经成为热门玩梗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061146116891.png
与此同时，也有玩家称这次电影的氛围相比过去更接近真正的恐怖游戏，尤其是怪物设计、封闭空间以及不断升级的压迫感，让人想起《死亡空间》。还有观众认为，导演扎克·克雷格显然没有把电影简单拍成传统商业恐怖片，而是加入了不少熟悉游戏玩家才能察觉的视觉语言。影片甚至被发现藏有“Leon S. Kennedy GUNS AND AMMO”的招牌彩蛋。
那么你觉得，新电影把病毒做得这么强是加分项，还是已经强到连里昂都不好打了？

items.title: "天使投资人"腾讯还在发力 只要游戏牛就愿意合作
items.summary: 腾讯游戏朱永毅近日接受《游戏商业》采访时表示，希望通过长期支持开发团队，培养出能够持续打造行业标杆作品的工作室。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061021092615.png
据Gamesrader报道，腾讯游戏朱永毅近日接受《游戏商业》采访时表示，《博德之门3》和《艾尔登法环》是腾讯游戏发展的“北极星”，腾讯希望通过长期支持开发团队，培养出能够持续打造行业标杆作品的工作室。
朱永毅表示，腾讯并不特别强调开发商来自哪个地区，更看重拥有独特愿景、持续打磨自身能力的开发者。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061025157082.png
他以拉瑞安和FromSoftware为例，称两家工作室都长期专注于特定游戏类型，并在多部作品中不断迭代，最终分别打造出了《博德之门3》和《艾尔登法环》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061025267591.png
他认为，腾讯对旗下内部工作室也希望采取类似策略：“如果你相信有一天自己能够成为某个类型的领导者，我们就愿意与你合作。可能是今天，也可能是两三款游戏之后，只要我们能看到进步，这就是长期承诺。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061025383722.png
朱永毅还特别提到了两家工作室的发展历程。《博德之门3》的成功并非一蹴而就，而是拉瑞安经历多部《神界》作品后逐渐积累的成果；FromSoftware则经历了《恶魔之魂》《黑暗之魂》《血源》等作品，最终推出《艾尔登法环》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610061025488483.png
目前，腾讯也持有拉瑞安少数股权，同时持有FromSoftware母公司角川的大量股份。朱永毅表示，腾讯希望通过长期合作，让开发团队逐步成长，而不是单纯追求短期回报。

items.title: 符合原著！五条悟雕像参展被吊灯砸成两半
items.summary: 一款《咒术回战》五条悟的手办样品，被头顶突然掉落的灯具直接砸中

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062208046930.jpeg
10月6日，2026上海Wonder Festival（WF）开展首日，展馆内就诞生了一个迅速出圈的名场面。在某个展台上，一款《咒术回战》五条悟的手办样品，被头顶突然掉落的灯具直接砸中，当场从腰部断成两截。照片和视频迅速在社交平台传播，毕竟在漫画中，五条悟正是被宿傩的“空间斩”拦腰斩断的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062208078368.png
WF全称Wonder Festival，由日本海洋堂于1984年创办，是全球规模最大、最具影响力的手办、雕像与GK原型模型展。上海WF作为其中国分站，自2018年起举办，现已发展为国内模玩圈最重磅的行业盛会。本届展会于10月3日至4日在上海新国际博览中心举办，展览面积达60000平方米，参展商超过750家，专业观众预计超过10万人次。
五条悟手办的“断腰”事件发生在开展首日，展台工作人员迅速处理了现场。有现场观众表示，灯具掉落的原因可能是展馆顶部结构问题，而非展台搭建不当。对于模玩爱好者来说，手办在展出中意外损毁并不罕见，但被灯具精准“腰斩”成原作同款姿势，确实称得上可遇不可求的巧合。

items.title: 《战争机器：事变日》借用Xbox Series S内置SSD，腾出约1GB内存实现60帧
items.summary: 在接受Digital Foundry采访时，《战争机器：事变日》开发商The Coalition的技术总监Kate Rayner透露，工作室将Xbox Series S的SSD用作临时内存，以提升《战争机器：事变日》的性

content.v: 在接受Digital Foundry采访时，《战争机器：事变日》开发商The Coalition的技术总监Kate Rayner透露，工作室将Xbox Series S的SSD用作临时内存，以提升《战争机器：事变日》的性能。她解释说，数据存储在三个地方：CPU缓存、内存和SSD，其中SSD的速度远低于前两者。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261006/1791295470_586519.webp
《战争机器：事变日》的开发团队利用内置固态硬盘（SSD）作为临时内存，来存储游戏中出现的城市数据。由于SSD的速度远低于内存，开发人员只存储了那些不会影响游戏加载速度的内存区域。
据雷纳称，利用固态硬盘上的几GB空间，可以额外获得大约1GB的系统内存。The Coalition工作室正是利用这一点，在不降低整体游戏质量的前提下，以60帧运行《战争机器：事变日》。
其他工作室已经在询问这一漏洞背后的技术。因此，得益于《战争机器：事变日》的开发工作，Xbox Series S移植版游戏性能不稳定的问题或许能够得到改善。此前，由于优化方面存在问题，一些开发者对Xbox Series S提出了严厉批评。

items.title: Warhammer Survivors Release Date Revealed Alongside a New Demo You Can Play Right Now
items.summary: Warhammer Survivors, the upcoming roguelite bullet heaven from Warhammer 40,000's Auroch Digital in partnershi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/warhammerbr-1791260854851.png

Warhammer Survivors , the upcoming roguelite bullet heaven from Warhammer 40,000's Auroch Digital in partnership with Vampire Survivors' poncle, will be released on November 10, 2026, on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, PC, and mobile.

Warhammer Survivors launches priced $7.99 / £6.39 / €7.49 with a 10% launch and preorder discount available on select platforms. If you have Xbox Game Pass, you'll be able to play it at no extra charge on day one.

Warhammer Survivors brings together two campaigns and over 40 playable characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, and that's in addition to over 75 weapons and more than 15 stages.

I want to spend a moment on the weapons, because there are not only those you'd expect from the world of Warhammer, including Neave Blacktalon's Tempest Axes and Malum Caedo's Chainsword, but also weapons inspired by the tabletop experience we all know and love. Yes, you can hurl Nuln Oil at enemies to drench them in a substance that makes them more susceptible to fire damage, or launch D6 Dice across the stage that explode if they land on the right number.
This is made even better by the fact that there is an actual Hobby Table stage that brings it all together in a glorious way.

We had the chance to try out Warhammer Survivors , and you can not only read our preview right here, but you can also play the exact same demo right now on PC via Steam or Xbox. This new demo added The Legend of Catachan and Lyssa Ravenya alongside improvements based on community feedback from the last demo.
Warhammer Survivors will also feature Extremis Bosses like the Norn Emissary that aim to be the most challenging content "even for Survivors-like veterans," a paint pot system, and so much more.

items.title: 机动战士高达Rogue Orbit给了我一把恶心的鞭剑，但却保留了我在机甲游戏中最想要的东西
items.summary: Let me put my own parts on my Gundam, dangit!

content.v: I didn't know I could have an entitled opinion about giant anime robots until I played a preview of Gundam Rogue Orbit, but it turns out I can. I'm mad because they gave me a Gundam with a whip sword straight out of Bloodborne (if Gundam hadn't actually gotten there first in the mid-'90s).

To be clear, I'm not mad at the whip sword itself. I'm ecstatic about the whip sword. It's exactly the kind of esoteric weapon that suggests Rogue Orbit has a real shot at being the kind of action game that I want out of Gundam—one with a bit more melee crunch and nuance than they tend to offer. But I can't help but look this gift sword in the mouth, because months after revealing the game, the Gundam team are still holding back hands-on with the bit I want to see most: a damn customization screen.

Why couldn't I look through a short list of weapons whitelisted for the demo build and have a chance to think: "Whip sword? Yes, I'll be having some of that." The fact that you can customize your mech in Rogue Orbit isn't secret: there's a screenshot of the menu on the freaking Steam page! Here's what it looks like:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qXnrWsozM7QYUCrKuqKaH3-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BPSSpzMixcZz9rcjLg2dJ3-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PV8UnwUhGgS7uacgmsChuU-1920-80.jpg

That looks cool. I would've loved to spend at least a few seconds pondering stats like "close-range power" and "output" before deciding a 60-foot-tall robot using a whip to channel its inner Belmont while fighting aliens is far too dope to resist, numbies be damned.

Demos always have to strike a balance between showing too much and not enough, risking a confusing amount of up-front complexity or a slice so thin it misses some of the fatty goodness that adds flavor. I played about 30 minutes of Rogue Orbit, which was all action, accompanied by plenty of anime-tinged voiceover about the aliens(?) called "The Apocalypse" that made me think I will probably not pay much attention to anything that happens in this story.

On the edginess scale, though, Rogue Orbit's got nothing on the likes of "XXXG-01D2 Gundam Deathscythe Hell" from Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz—you can practically feel the impending turn of the millennium oozing from every letter in that cursed name. Rogue Orbit may not be the politically tinged deliberation on war I love from the best Gundam shows, but that's okay—it's doing something different, and the combo-heavy action immediately made me feel like the game was on to something.

Rogue Orbit skews a bit more action RPG than Devil May Cry—the combos are just a few repeated button presses, and much of your damage comes from throwing in active skills which each have their own cooldowns. Holding a trigger and tapping Square on a PlayStation pad made my Gundam swirl the whip sword around in a 360 degree frenzy, catching anyone nearby in a flurry of quick hits.

Another weapon, the Sword Lance, almost felt Monster Hunter-inspired, building up a unique meter every time I performed a heavy lunging attack mid-dodge. That meter could then be spent to spawn a "Beam Phalanx" of laser-spewing orbs.
Damage numbers, on by default, increase the sense that in the full game I'll be monitoring skill cooldowns a la Granblue Fantasy: Relink as much as I am focusing on attack timing or perfect dodges.

This is, nevertheless, the closest any Gundam game I've ever played has felt like FromSoftware's sublime Armored Core 6. A gentler, "have fun pressing buttons and watch shiny particles go everywhere" cousin, to be sure, but a cousin nonetheless.

It's sort of a cute full-circle moment: In the pre-Dark Souls days, FromSoftware developed several Gundam games for Bandai Namco around the same time it was putting out Armored Core: For Answer and Armored Core 5. The learner has become the master, and so on. If the current Gundam dev team looked at AC6 with envy and decided to replicate it for a slightly less hardcore audience, I think that was a wise move, and I also think, at least based on my early impressions, that they've pulled it off.

But it still feels like I haven't seen the most important bit. So much of the joy of Armored Core—of any proper mech game, really—is assembling a build before tackling a mission, trying to find that balance of speed and durability, raw damage and ammo capacity, range and up-close stopping power that fits the coming threat.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/a987H2u68DUbPQBvyJDXD3-1920-80.jpg
Demo practicality be damned—until I'm putting that whip sword in my Gundam's hand myself, I won't know for certain if this is the next great mech action game or not. The full game is out in March.

items.title: 战锤幸存者不仅仅是吸血鬼幸存者的衍生作品
items.summary: Even as we drown in Warhammer games, Survivors stands out as something extremely cool.

content.v: I thought Warhammer Survivors sounded like a neat spin-off—Vampire Survivors in a Warhammer skin, created by Boltgun developer Auroch Digital. Having spent 10 hours with its demo, however, I'm increasingly convinced that it deserves to be catagorised as a sequel.

A lot of care has clearly gone into the hero design, maps and all the horrible beasties trying to eviscerate you, and rather than simply replicate Vampire Survivors, Auroch Digital has included a bunch of novelties and new ideas, like followers and more overt boss battles.

Playing it on my Steam Deck has already had a terrible impact on my sleep routine, just like its predecessor. And with its launch just around the corner on November 10, I think I'm just going to have to accept that I'm going to be very tired for the rest of the year.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9xs2BMSqoLdhhvhWRwC4pX.png
Everything you dig about Vampire Survivors is here too

Weapon evolutions, enemies that drop chests with multiple items, arcana, bosses, challenges, upgrades—if it's in Vampire Survivors, it's probably in Warhammer Survivors, albeit with some Warhammer-themed twists. Instead of experience gems, for instance, you get experience skulls (because of course you do). And instead of Red Death, you get Extremis bosses, massive seemingly invincible bastards—until you figure out the trick to destroying them.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SWa2n2BJR8qAWCyx4E2XPX.jpg
Nuln oil is deadly

I have used buckets of Nuln oil in my Warhammer painting endeavours—and yes, I've spilled a lot of it. On my jeans, on my carpet, one time on my dog. But it's never hurt anyone. In Warhammer Survivors, it's been weaponised, damaging and slowing ememies, as well as making them more flammable. You'll also be able to get your hands on explosive dice, which roll across the battlefield before going kaboom! I'm sure there are rules against this.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RQ3nKL292Q9WXf9Nu83N4X.png
Each map has a strong theme

The first WH40k map sees you running around a battlefield that's being swallowed up by tyranids. It's aggressively pink and full of horrible pustules and grotesque alien topography. In Age of Sigmar, meanwhile, it's skaven time! Nasty little rodents, glowing warpstones, you know the deal. There's even a map that's just your tabletop, full of paints and measuring tape, where all the game's monstrosities gather together to take you out.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VLKG7pnpE8wXdkY4pjQGsX.png
You're not alone

While Warhammer Survivors is a singleplayer romp, that doesn't mean you're all alone. Unlockable characters can be rescued once you defeat the enemies harassing them, after which they'll join you in battle. In subsequent fights, they'll rejoin you when you select one of their associated weapons when you level up. At least one character gets buffs from having more followers, and upgrading his lasgun also lets him run around with his fellow Astra Militarum grunts.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YW2NNQVgcH2N7nk9zaujX.jpg
It's tough!

I've poured hundreds of hours into Vampire Survivors, and Warhammer Survivors might be a bit trickier. Battles escalate a lot faster, and it took me longer to figure out good weapon combos that worked to thin the herd. I was a lot more desperate for healing than I'm used to with its predecessor. I think I'd prefer the early game to be slightly less intense, though the issue might be that the demo features fewer weapons and characters, which could be making it feel a touch more challenging than it actually is.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SWa2n2BJR8qAWCyx4E2XPX.jpg
Enemy factions have unique traits

Enemy factions benefit from unique traits that may give you a bit of a hard time. Tyranids, for instance, can be empowered by more intelligent members of their species, which use their synapse power to enrage lesser critters within their radius. So you'll want to take these psychic beasties down quickly. Orks, meanwhile, can get all riled up, kicking off a WAAAGH, where they spawn in greater numbers and become faster and stronger.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RPwMkzRskHZrGkN9fCn4pX.png
WH40k and AoS are completely separate

When you play Warhammer Survivors, you select a universe first. Characters, upgrades and unlocks are specific to each universe, though you will find some passive abilities repeated in both. It feels like two spin-offs collected in a single game.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MCHYGyHVt36R8dSJu95EBX.png
It already works perfectly on Steam Deck

Vampire Survivors is the game that really justified my purchase of a Steam Deck, and while developer Auroch Digital still says it's working on compatibility, it already feels great on my Deck. It's where I've spent most of my time playing it and I've got no complaints.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5mLHtMPGXEy793NUQZPJdX.png
It's almost here, thank the Emperor

Cancel all of your plans in November, because Warhammer Survivors is launching on the 10th. And I've got high hopes for it. Yes, it's a spin-off, but it also feels like a proper Vampire Survivors sequel and potentially my favourite bullet heaven since the OG.

items.title: 华纳兄弟游戏现在属于 Skydance，但该公司在重大公告中没有提及这一点
items.summary: Paramount has officially completed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, but the company's a

content.v: Paramount has officially completed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, but the company's announcement of the deal closing did not contain a single mention of video games. That's notable because Warner Bros. Discovery is heavily invested in video games, and many may wonder what's coming next.

CEO David Ellison says he is a big gamer himself , but whether or not that means anything for the future of games at the new company, now known as Skydance, is unknown. Ellison, the son of billionaire Oracle founder Larry Ellison, courted controversy due to his family's dealings with Donald Trump and the current administration, with some industry observers believing the close relationship helped get the deal through the regulatory process.

Netflix originally secured the top bid for WBD and believed its deal would close, but Paramount swooped in with more money and a contract to buy the whole company, not just parts of it like Netflix was planning. For its part, Netflix executives spent time with Trump and his team as well. Co-CEO Ted Sarandos recently praised Trump for believing in and supporting the entertainment industry.

Skydance's press release announcing the closing of the deal hypes up Ellison's stated plans to put a minimum of 30 "high-quality" movies in theaters annually, and touts its "creative-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, and globally scaled" setup, but doesn't mention video games at all.

The news release does mention that the combined companies will offer content for people "across every entertainment vertical," and that would seemingly include video games. But the brief does not include any specifics. GameSpot has followed up with Skydance seeking more information.

Speaking to staff, Skydance boss Ynon Kreiz mentioned games specifically. According to The Hollywood Reporter , he said the company will have "plenty of opportunities to develop new businesses, products, games, and experiences to engage fans wherever they are and be where the consumer is going."

For what it's worth, when Netflix was planning to buy WBD, the streaming giant was similarly quiet on its plans for video games, saying it did not factor in video games very much . This came despite how 2023's Hogwarts Legacy was a bonafide juggernaut, selling more than 30 million copies.

While the release doesn't mention video games specifically, it does call out scary and tough times ahead for the people who work there. One of the main bullet points in the release was that Skydance is planning at least $6 billion in "run-rate syngeries within three years," which is likely a forecast for layoffs and cuts. Skydance's official word, however, is that the savings will "primarily" come from "technology, integration and procurement, marketing and real estate rationalization."
When big companies combine, layoffs often happen--it was the case for Microsoft, too, when it bought Activision Blizzard, with the company slashing thousands of jobs.

Skydance recently rolled out Paramount Games Studio, a team that folded in Skydance Interactive and Skydance New Media. Projects in the works at those studios are continuing, including Marvel 1943: Rise of Hyrdra and a new Star Wars game with Lucasfilm from Amy Hennig, now under the Paramount Games Studio banner.

With Skydance now running the show, the company takes ownership of numerous big gaming properties , including Hogwarts Legacy developer Avalanche Software and its publishing label, Portkey Games; Mortal Kombat and its developer, NetherRealm; and Batman: Arkham studio Rocksteady. Skydance is also now in charge of Lego developer TT Games, and numerous other developers, including WB Games Boston, WB Games Montreal, WB Games New York, WB Games San Francisco, and numerous other studios.
Beyond developing games themselves, Skydance is making the Call of Duty movie with Activision , which is due for release in 2028.

items.title: Modern Warships Dev Causes Actual Art Storm After Plagiarizing Ship Design
items.summary: Artstorm, developer of PvP naval warfare game Modern Warships, has admitted to using an independent artist’s c

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/warship-1791293810323.jpg

Artstorm, developer of PvP naval warfare game Modern Warships, has admitted to using an independent artist’s creation as the basis for one of its ship designs. The plagiarism came to light yesterday when concept artist Alex Jay Brady posted the similarities between their creation and the ship model in-game.

Brady’s art, a design for an atomic ekranoplan carrier vessel, was shown side-by-side against the in-game model in Modern Warships, called the RF Bartini A-2000-7. Even a casual onlooker could see the similarities.

I did not give @ModernWarships permission to use my ekrano design, but I have to say she's looking great. Much more detailed than my sketches. Honestly if they'd just asked and sent me some $$$$ Id have had zero issue with them using it. Its not to late to do the right thing guys https://t.co/E2K7z3rE9i

IGN reached out to Brady for more information. “For me the design is the same, with a few minor differences,” Brady said. “The location of the AWACs dish (and there being two, which I assume has something to do with the technical requirements of the game necessitating symmetry?) the number of engines etc…

“But as there never was a swing wing ekranoplan carrier (for good reason) and every detail aside from that is carried over from my design, it seems cut and dried. I have all the project files including, for example, the lines on the deck. The design makes little sense from a realism pov; the engines wash across the deck, the planes take off backward, not into the wind, I just didn't know anything about the subject when building it and they cloned all those mistakes wholesale.”

Since the tweet grew in popularity, developer Artstorm has reached out to Brady, who will consider “the issue closed” and the images added to their portfolio “as a roundabout piece of contract work” if they accept any offer made. Publisher Gaijin told IGN the Modern Warships team had responded to Brady on X, but declined to offer any more detail.

In a tweet reply to Brady, Artstorm said: “Fair call, and apologies from us. Your design was used as a reference without proper clearance. We’ll contact you directly to make this right.” Brady is currently waiting to see what the developer offers in exchange for using their work as a basis of an in-game design.

To unlock the carrier in-game, players would have to spend between $50-100 on gacha spins. Alternatively, players could purchase it with in-game currency, with the RF Bartini A-2000-7 averaging between 7,000 AC and 15,000+ AC (ArtCoins). The average cost of AC is roughly $100 for 1,300 to 2,000 AC. At this rate, a ship costing 10,000 AC would technically cost $500-700+, with a bit of wiggle either side depending on market price fluctuations.

Many Steam reviews of Modern Warships complain about the pricing of the free-to-play title’s more effective vessels. As one put it: “This game is absolutely terrible. The developers and moderators seem to be far more interested in making money from players than in making a balanced and enjoyable game. They are theives [sic].”

items.summary: Time flies by fast, especially if you're Sega's blue mascot, as 2026 marks the 35th anniversary of Sonic the H

content.v: Time flies by fast, especially if you're Sega's blue mascot, as 2026 marks the 35th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog . While Sega has various plans to commemorate the milestone, one of the most elegant is a hand-painted porcelain sculpture that is both graceful and expensive . Even if you can afford to shell out big bucks for this Blue Blur pottery, you'll still need luck on your side, as only 50 of these pieces are being made.

Sculpted by the artisans of the Japanese studio YOYOYO, this ornate piece costs a whopping $7,000. It comes with a certificate of authenticity, a wooden stand, and a wooden box, but you'll need to enter a lottery to have a chance to buy it.

So what makes this piece so special? To realize the idea of Sonic being the "world's fastest blue," the studio incorporated gosu, a cobalt-blue underglaze pigment that results in a color that never fades. This created an "eternal blue" finish, and the artisans also designed this sculpture to have a shelf-life of at least 100 years.

For the base, durable Amakusa porcelain stone was chosen, as its white surface lets colors shine through, and the artists used techniques like delicate underglaze painting to create Seigaiha and Shippo patterns. This requires incredible skill and concentration to pull off successfully, as the patterns are ornate and hard to keep uniform. This is time-consuming, back-breaking work to do once, let alone 50 times, but the neat thing is that each piece will be unique up close, so you can appreciate the subtle details of the craft.

The red is also special, as it's applied to the partner piece that expresses the an endless infinity trail. According to the artists, glossy red carries motion and heat, and they also change expression with the viewing angle.

Other neat details include the other blue hues chosen for this project, with the Yagasuri shade featuring a stylized arrow-feather pattern to symbolize strong forward motion. You can take a closer look at how this work of Sonic the Hedgehog art was put together in the video above, which features a detailed (and enjoyably soothing) look at the artistry involved.

It might be a major anniversary year for Sonic the Hedgehog, but strangely, there's no game tie-in to mark the occasion. Sonic has had a consistent run of releases throughout the 2020s--with titles like Sonic Colors: Ultimate (2021), Sonic Frontiers (2022), Sonic Superstars (2023), Sonic X Shadow Generations (2024), and Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds (2025)--but it looks like the franchise is taking a break in 2026. While work continues on the next mainline game, Sega is leaning into updates for Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds alongside merchandise and community events to celebrate the decades-spanning career of its icon.

items.title: Deadlock 不再是 MOBA 或第三人称射击游戏——《不眠之城》将其变成了恐怖游戏
items.summary: Can't a little guy find some peace in the tunnels?

content.v: Ignore the section tag for this article, because while Deadlock may technically have the DNA of a MOBA or a third-person shooter, it is actually a horror game, and a bloody scary one at that.

How did I come to this hypothesis, you ask? Well, a few reasons come to mind, including one huge one that loves pizza. You see, I predominantly play Rem, and one of Rem's perks is that he can run around the maze of tunnels beneath the map, farming souls and just generally getting up to no good. Until recently I was largely left alone in said tunnels; I hardly ever play against a Calico and Mo and Krill rarely use them.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PSXgeqU4ZBVEnwaLVB45RJ-1920-80.jpg

And then came Deadlock's latest major update City Never Sleeps , which brought six new heroes, the first of which being the Rat King . Ironically I actually voted for the Rat King, and that decision haunts me.

Picture this. I'm skedaddling around the tunnels minding my own business when, in the corner of my eye I see something staring at me from the end of one of the adjacent tunnels. It's the Rat King, he's seen me, and he's running my way.

I throw everything I have at the rat but that still isn't enough to defeat him. I decide my only option is to turn tail and run, the only problem with that is that when you're locked in combat the map closes down the exits and entrances to the tunnels, something I forgot until I ran head first into a grated exit. Needless to say I died in that cold dark tunnel, and there wasn't much I could've done about it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/x8gAo3KLBdR3sFP2fStKee-1920-80.jpg

I have been jumpscared by that bloody giant rat more times than I care to admit. Each time I enter the tunnels now my blood runs cold, marred by memories of him hunting me down and throwing Miguel, Jacques, or Abbie with an I at me.

But the horror isn't restricted to the tunnels. Just the other night I was walking through one of the new districts, Chinatown, and accidentally crossed paths with the enemy Abrams. At first I thought that he might not have seen me. I was wrong. I looked back just once to see him right behind me, before I knew it I'd been shoved into the wall and the enemy Seven appeared out of thin air to solo ult me for some ungodly reason.

Perhaps I'm too horror-coded for my own good, and thanks to this I managed to find myself in terrifying scenarios no matter what game I play. But I'm also of the mindset that any online multiplayer game is inherently scary simply because of the fact that people are unpredictable and are almost always out for blood.

items.title: Steam Frame 在许多其他人都犯错的地方实现了 VR 的正确方向
items.summary: The virtual reality market has grown over the years, and depending on your budget, there's probably a VR heads

content.v: The virtual reality market has grown over the years, and depending on your budget, there's probably a VR headset out there for you. But can your VR gaming budget stretch to over $1,000 for the entry-level Steam Frame headset , and is it even worthwhile? That's the question GameSpot's senior video producer Kurt Indovina set out to answer, and after spending some time with it, his main takeaway was that it's the best VR headset he's ever used, and possibly the last one he'll ever own.

"Having used this solid piece of tech for a couple of weeks now, it's been great to replay things like Half-Life: Alyx or booting up Ghost Town, or fiddling around in Hot Dogs, Horseshoes, and Hand Grenades," Indovina explained. "It's also been a time of reflection for VR as a whole, from where it started, where it went, and where it currently sits now. I've been an advocate for VR for a while. I've made plenty of videos about VR. In fact, the first GameSpot video I ever appeared in was for Five Nights at Freddy's VR."

"But for all of the love I've given VR, my gripes with it seem to be never-ending. I've been very vocal about how companies have stunted the growth of VR and are trying to chokehold the market with their product. Meta putting out the most affordable and accessible headset only to commit, for lack of a better term, public suicide by investing everything into the metaverse, favoring a dystopian weird social life and alienating people who just want to play games."
But if you look at the Steam Frame in a vacuum? "It rules," Indovina said. "I'm sure this thing will get support for a lot of other cool games. It's great."

The Steam Frame isn't the first time that Valve has launched VR hardware, but compared to 2019's Valve Index, this standalone wireless headset is a major leap forward. It offers inside-out tracking, improved streaming support, onboard processing, and Android compatibility, but it is one of the pricier models on the market right now. It's still cheaper than Meta's next foray into virtual reality, as the Facebook parent company recently unveiled its new $1,300 Meta VR Glasses , with a flashy trailer that didn't even mention VR gaming.

But if you've got the cash to flash and you're purely interested in gaming, the Steam Frame is worth considering, if you can get your hands on one, since they've sold out surprisingly fast. If you wear glasses, you'll also want to double-check your frame and avoid making an expensive purchase for high-tech VR gear you can't use.

根据官方表述，这一次的新品 NxLOGI 芯片带来 HERO2 传感器优化，续航直接能拉到 135 小时，比上代的 90 小时提高了 50%，这对于游戏和日常办公的人群来说都是相当好的纸面数据。
https://image.gcores.com/434285d3ad792d0b1c32cf9c17dcadc4-4080-3064.jpg
既然说到电磁微动，GPW5 ULTRA 的调校和上代也保持一致，10 档触发、5 档 RT 快速触发而且支持 6 档触感反馈强度的调节。对于喜欢特别精细去调整力反馈的玩家来说值得好好在软件中找一找适合自己的档位。
https://image.gcores.com/5bb093e0f89550fb9f9786cd19bc5198-1519-1137.png
另外大伙也可以试试 GHUB 里套用职业选手的 HITS 预设，兴许某一套就很适合你。而且这种触发对于大部分玩家来说还是比较新，相比传统微动，电磁在触感还是蛮新鲜，不过好处就是触发响应更快，以及不存在机械磨损。
https://image.gcores.com/af43abd4fe1cf8898869a619b04f8199-4384-2920.jpg
PRO X2 RT参天8K电竞磁轴键盘是游戏场景中另一个不可或缺的部分。先说体感部分，PRO X2 RT 有 6 层消音结构，搭配罗技定制轴体，整体声音控制非常好，另外盒子内还搭配了软胶掌托。
https://image.gcores.com/46029c1e90c11ee6661c800c3ec4f11d-4384-2920.jpg
作为磁轴键盘，8K 回报率、高精度的 RT（快速触发）都会让玩家在输入端有更可靠的保障。所谓 RT 也就是 Rapid Trigger，不熟悉的各位可以理解为其不同于传统机械轴的工作原理，玩家可以自己定义按钮的触发和复位的深度，而不是每次都要依照机械轴体固定的按键深度。从而能让玩家拥有潜在的、更高的触发效率，让键盘完全符合自己的手部力度。
https://image.gcores.com/0493381a6562344c8a02cc9bab21cbb1-1519-1141.png
另外 SOCD 功能应该伴随着一种 FPS 游戏被广大玩家所了解，（其实我知道这定义还是在用 hitbox 打《街霸》的时候），这也算是近年来比较流行的功能亮点了。尤其眼看着 COD 就要发售，哪怕是对触发时机 1% 的提升，或许都能救人一命。
https://image.gcores.com/0aa00ed4d9f4fc34f657a17287a65f8b-1516-1129.png
说到亮点，键盘右侧的小屏幕也做到实用性至上——像单键触发点调节、快速触发、SOCD 参数和灯效，都可以通过下方滚轮和按钮进行调整，我们甚至可以在这块小屏幕上单独调节某一个按键的触发深度，而且操作逻辑也很清晰。当然，以上只是夸一下其小屏的实用性，真正调校依旧是推荐各位进 GHUB 的。
https://image.gcores.com/13a98b58cb0aac27148e51285107f790-4384-2920.jpg
最后，还有这款罗技G PRO X3 无线游戏耳机，这款耳机使用场景很丰富，盒中配了 2.4G、3.5mm 和 2.5mm 音频线，允许用户按使用习惯连接，麦克风也是可拔插式设计。
https://image.gcores.com/581de19e6434c13430509ce60e0d47ee-4384-2920.jpg
耳机本体重约 356g，头梁较软而且是带孔的皮革设计，整体宽松不夹头，夏天使用应该也不会有不适感。另外值得一夸的是耳罩，包容空间也比较大，而且整体的续航拉到了 70 小时的纸面数据。
https://image.gcores.com/21869b83b105be52f567642dad0ba654-4384-2920.jpg
另外多提一句，G PRO X3 无线游戏耳机采用的是 50mm 石墨烯驱动单元，据官方介绍这样的工艺可以让振膜兼具轻薄与坚硬，减少音频失真，提供更好的空间辨识体验。我也非常期待《战争机器 事变日》还有即将发售的《使命召唤 现代战争 4》多人模式能带给我更好的声音体验。
调校方面，这次的 G PRO X3 支持 10 档 EQ 调节，甚至连麦克风的 EQ 都可以调，大家也可以套用别人提供的预设数据，针对不同的游戏类型寻找最佳听感。而最远 30 米的无线距离也让用户日常佩戴时多了一份安心。
整体用下来新的 G PRO 产品线为深度用户提供了多一份可玩性，GHUB 的参数调校可以让每个人都找到最适合自己的参数组合，优秀的工艺和改进的纸面参数也确实给电竞游戏爱好者提供了多一层选择空间，有机会的话各位也可以实际体验一下～

items.title: Prime Day Deal Knocks 25% Off MTG Marvel Draft Night Box With Free Collector Booster
items.summary: Amazon’s Prime Day deal drops the Magic: The Gathering Marvel Draft Night Box to $89.99, letting you snag a ra

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/02/draft-night-header-1780387582600.jpg
Magic is in the midst of a Reality Fracture right now, but if you’re looking for the priciest cards from the Marvel Super Heroes set, Collector Boosters are the way to go.
The only issue is that, despite the fact that the set is months old now, Collector Boosters remain tricky to get hold of.

Thankfully, one Amazon Prime Day deal makes it a little easier to get hold of one, and the math on what else is included in the Draft Night Bundle makes it a better value proposition than you may expect.
Right now, it’s been reduced by 25% off the list price , bringing it from $119.99 down to $89.99, but that only tells half the story.
This Marvel x Magic Deal is a Prime Day Winner

Inside the Magic: The Gathering Marvel Super Heroes Draft Night box, you’ll find everything you need for four players to draft from sealed Play Booster packs, with the winner getting to go home with that all-important shiny Collector Booster pack.
That means there are 12 Play Boosters, 90 lands to help you build decks, and the Play Booster, so let’s crunch the numbers.

If a Play Booster is $6.99 on its own, those make up $83.88 of value on their own. The basic lands, while useful, are essentially bulk, so you’re getting a Collector Booster for around $6 in many ways

That one pack would usually cost around $40, so you’re saving big on it here. These special packs are more expensive (and rarer) because they essentially offer the best (read: essentially only) way to get the rarest cards in their set .
And, given that there are cards like the comic cover art treatments, The Mind Stone’s expensive variants, and more, you may strike lucky.
Plus, you know, playing Draft is great fun anyway, so we’d always recommend giving it a go if Commander night is getting a little stale for your playgroup.

items.summary: Investigating the RPG's detective systems.

content.v: I have technically solved a lot of crimes from the comfort of my gaming chair, but it's surprisingly rare for games to actually engage with the mechanics of a criminal investigation. You'll chat to folk, maybe use your 'detective vision', and then the culprit is found. Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy asks more from you.

As an agent of the Inquisition, solving crimes and putting away heretics is your business. You don't complete quests, you solve cases, log evidence, make accusations, torture and snoop—all in a universe where your word is law.

Owlcat's given us a quick breakdown of Dark Heresy's detective systems in the video above, but like my favourite inquisitor, Gregor Eisenhorn , I wanted to dig a little deeper and put some questions to Veronika Larionova, Owlcat's senior narrative designer.
Is the detective system exclusively based on things that we've seen in the books and other games, or are there brand new elements that Owlcat created from scratch?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oGfyrKFo94v4CKzSwvm2u-1920-80.png
What tools do inquisitors have at their disposal when it comes to their detective work?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JMf39DEhb7AUzfftsgA5Q3-1920-80.png
How do NPC companions factor into the detective system?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/A8dgCfEnuMbywuvdcKUJJ3-1920-80.png
Can you conclude an investigation whenever you want, based on thin evidence?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3mQmZt5YqwkuLzmP7UG3N3-1920-80.png

Is it possible to conclude an investigation successfully just through luck—like picking a culprit at random? And will the outcome be different if you got the right person but failed to collect all the evidence?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v78PjumwQUnXiVJkZUejge-1920-80.png
What sort of repercussions are there for getting it wrong?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3w3gakhuhq4GjDpGuBPhG3-1920-80.png
Can the player benefit from purposefully pinning something on the wrong group or person?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/r5DvoyifTbm9ysT8Vyin53-1920-80.png
Can we essentially play as Eisenhorn—not the character himself, of course, but exclusively making the kinds of choices that Eisenhorn would make?

items.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Appears to Solve All of Switch Sports’ Shortcomings | IGN Preview
items.summary: I’m stunned at how excited I am for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. I plan to 100% this game, which is not some

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/ns2-nintendoswitchsportsresort-scrn-14-1791266095527.png
Key Preview Takeaways:

Pack my bags and book me a one-way ticket to Wuhu Island. After its announcement in June, I was mildly excited for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, mostly because of the prospect of returning to Nintendo’s vacation paradise after more than a decade since my last visit in Pilotwings Resort on 3DS launch day. After my first hands-on at San Diego Comic Con, I walked away filled with fuzzy nostalgia, but questioning how much a motion controlled sports party game could grab my attention in 2026, a full 20 years after the original Wii Sports had its TV-smashing moment. But after playing another hour plus and seeing how much fun I had in multiplayer, and how much there is to do in single player, it’s vaulted up to be one of my most anticipated games for the rest of the year. What’s happening here?

One key demographic for the Switch Sports series that I don’t fall into is the casual Nintendo gamer: someone who has Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Super Mario Party, the original Nintendo Switch Sports, maybe a Jackbox Party Pack or two, and not much else. You know, someone who has never had to click the “Show More” icon on their Switch because they don’t have enough games to fill the initial row. To be clear, there’s absolutely nothing wrong with that type of player: many of my friends have Switch home screens that look exactly like that. Nintendo is bundling Nintendo Switch Sports Resort with the Switch 2 this holiday season, and in terms of getting that audience to upgrade, I think it’s a really smart move. Resort will be a great time for anyone with nostalgia for the original who just likes to pick up and play fun, simple games with their friends. That was never in doubt.

What has been in doubt is how much a player like me will get out of Resort, with so many other huge games constantly fighting for my attention. I was especially wondering this following 2022’s somewhat disappointing Nintendo Switch Sports, which I felt lacked compelling reasons to play it at launch and relied far too much on online play to get much out of it. I was ready to accept that Resort would be a game I play a little bit at a time for a very long time, breaking it out with friends or family on game nights over the course of the entire Switch 2 generation. And there is room in a library for games like that! So I was happy for it to play that role in my life. But I no longer feel this way: I’m ready for a weeks-long stay on Wuhu Island.

I think that’s mostly because Resort appears to be solving all of Switch Sports’ shortcomings. Spocco Square was nothing more than a video game menu that existed purely for you to select your next minigame. Wuhu Island is a place designed for competition, exploration, and leisure. Take Power Cruising (a trademark-free term for Jet Skiing) as an example. I can race my friends on a course that rewards speed and taking huge jumps off the waves as we bob and weave through obstacles just off of Wuhu’s shores.

Or, we can take a sightseeing tour of the water, taking five minutes to find as many landmarks as we can. Here, there are objectives and achievements to check off: I chased a pink dolphin until it rewarded me with a collectible, and elsewhere I had to line myself up to launch off a huge wave to grab another sparkly thing just out of my reach. At the end of the five-minute round, we saw an overhead view of the island, complete with a tracing of the path my co-op partner and I took around the island, reminiscent of Breath of the Wild’s Hero’s Path feature. We laughed at seeing where we went different directions, and when we met back up, and we talked about what we’d seen and discovered. I didn’t get to try this, but I’m told that there’s a free play mode for certain sports like Power Cruising where you can explore and chill for as long as you’d like with no timer; you just can’t unlock collectibles and achievements in that mode. This is just one sport, but there are many different ways to engage with it: competition, exploration, and leisure.

In a way, modes like this feel like a more successful realization of Mario Kart World’s Free Roam. You can easily explore in splitscreen with friends, collectibles and achievements are clearly marked and tracked, and they earn you points that can be spent on cosmetics for your Sportsmate or Mii character. It all feels fun, seamless to play with others, and well thought out in terms of rewards and goals to chase. And the denser, more self-contained layout of Wuhu Island means every area has something meaningful to uncover.

I explored Wuhu Island from two different angles in Skateboarding and Prop Plane. Skateboarding makes use of the Joy-Con 2 mouse controls, where I dragged the controller backwards as if it was my foot and my leg was the ground. I leaned left and right to turn, flicked the controller up to jump, and waggled it around to do spins and tricks in the air. I grinded on rails, crashed into the ocean to see what would happen (my character drowned and was returned to shore), and tried to find a path up to the island’s iconic volcano: Maka Wuhu. I ran out of time before I made it there.

So I took to the skies instead, using my plane to fly straight into the mouth of the volcano, as I did countless times in Pilotwings Resort back in the day. I was pleased to find a collectible deep within the volcano to reward my efforts. Soaring around the island revealed how much it has changed over the years: the distant golf course has a new resort hotel, there are additional smaller keys surrounding the main island, and the geography of everything has been shuffled a bit. The skies of Wuhu were stuffed with things to find: Landmarks to photograph and make note of, balloons to pop, and more. I spent a lot of time trying to use my water gun to shoot down my co-op partner, to no avail. Even with all this stuff to find and do, goofing around with no goal or objective is just as fun as it always was, and in part what I think this game is made for. It’s summer vacation! You’re supposed to just laze around and have fun.

But you can still turn up the heat when it’s time to compete. Thumb Wrestling will likely be a bore against the computer – it’s just too simple – but against a human opponent, it’s absolutely hilarious as you try to bait the other person to put their thumb down, and just laugh at the absurdity of two adults digitally thumb wrestling each other. We also bowled, and it’s pretty much unchanged from Wii Sports’ original winning formula, but it’s honestly still a classic. I played Archery again, too, which remains one of my all-time favorites. This time, we played a competitive mode where one quarter of the target is assigned to each player. That means it’s risky to aim for a bullseye: if you miss your quarter of the center and hit someone else’s, you hand them a bunch of points. As the round progresses, the target will start to rotate, or adjust the size of each quadrant to put the leader at a disadvantage to allow for last-second comebacks, which is a very fun – and very Nintendo – way to keep things interesting.

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062056525371.jpg

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062056347266.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062056374866.jpg

items.title: “粤J2888T”战绩全网可查 网友：见到此车注意避让
items.summary: 近日，一辆车牌为粤J2888T的白色奥迪，因一次带路乌龙被网友戏称为“广东公路甲级战犯”，今年国庆自驾至洛阳景区获专属车位，再次…

content.v: 近日，一辆车牌为粤J2888T的白色奥迪，因一次带路乌龙被网友戏称为“广东公路甲级战犯”，今年国庆自驾至洛阳景区获专属车位，再次引爆全网热。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261006_zy_red_164_23/172.jpg
2026年国庆，车主自驾至河南洛阳重渡沟景区，景区用路锥专门为其围出独立车位，发文称“大家放心游览”。车主抵达洛阳后，网友纷纷调侃“见到此车注意避让”，其动向被实时播报，话题#粤J2888T战绩全网可查#热度居高不下。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261006_zy_red_164_23/1186.jpg
2024年10月高速大堵车，粤J2888T女车主想抄近道，拐入一条乡间小路。后方近百辆车误以为她是本地老司机，纷纷跟随，结果路尽头被水泥桩封死，所有车辆只能艰难倒车数公里才脱困。这段大型堵车乌龙视频传遍网络，让这个车牌号被全网记住。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261006_zy_red_164_23/1306.jpg
网友戏称其“驾驶熟练度30%，事故处理熟练度300%”，提车以来小剐蹭、撞石墩、冲绿化带等事故不断。网传车辆除司机外，零件几乎换了个遍，保险费用也因此大幅上涨。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261006_zy_red_164_23/1390.jpg

content.v: 扎克·克雷格执导的新版《生化危机》电影上映不到三周，全球票房已超过2.5亿美元。新版电影并没有直接搬用游戏故事或沿用玩家熟悉的主角，而是围绕一名原创角色在浣熊市的遭遇展开。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261006/1791290775_141189_jpg_r.jpg
外媒估计，影片制作预算约为7500万至8000万美元；其北美首周末票房为6015万美元，美国累计票房超过1.248亿美元，国际市场票房约为1.205亿美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261006/1791290777_385205.jpg
影片由奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯饰演医疗快递员布莱恩。他在浣熊市遭遇疫情与怪物，缺少战斗训练的身份让故事从普通人的视角展开。稀缺的弹药和压迫性的环境，让影片更接近《生化危机》游戏的生存恐怖体验。新片由此选择借用游戏的处境与氛围，而非直接重演已有的游戏剧情。

items.summary: 游戏导演的复仇者联盟式的集会

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062043331962.png
《任天堂明星大乱斗》系列制作人樱井政博于10月5日在X上发布了一张游戏导演聚会的合照，配文称这是“游戏导演的复仇者联盟式的集会”。推文浏览量迅速突破2788万次，在游戏圈引发广泛关注。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/06/small_202610062041417300.png
这份名单几乎覆盖了日本游戏行业最具作者性的导演群体。三上真司、神谷英树、须田刚一、外山圭一郎四人曾共同参与《英雄不再》等作品的合作，私交甚笃；横尾太郎与上田文人则分别以叙事实验和极简美学著称。托比·福克斯作为《传说之下》的独立开发者出现在这张日本导演为主的合照中，尤为引人注目。
